## 1. Brand & Positioning
Duyuf Alrahman VIP provides private executive chauffeur transfers for Umrah pilgrims and international travelers in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. Operating across Jeddah, Makkah, and Madinah (Riyadh available when enabled by feature flag).

## 2. Fleet Specifications
- **Toyota Camry Executive**: 4 passengers, 3 standard luggage bags.
- **Hyundai Staria VIP**: 7 passengers, 6 luggage bags.
- **GMC Yukon XL VIP**: 7 passengers, 8 luggage bags.
- **Toyota HiAce Family Minibus**: 10 passengers, 10 luggage bags.

## 3. Authoritative Route Matrix (SAR)
- Jeddah Airport to Makkah: Camry 200 | Staria 260 | Yukon XL 380 | HiAce 340
- Makkah to Jeddah Airport: Camry 200 | Staria 260 | Yukon XL 380 | HiAce 340
- Makkah to Madinah: Camry 450 | Staria 500 | Yukon XL 750 | HiAce 650
- Madinah to Makkah: Camry 450 | Staria 500 | Yukon XL 750 | HiAce 650
- Madinah Airport to Hotel: Camry 150 | Staria 190 | Yukon XL 280 | HiAce 250
- Jeddah to Madinah: Camry 680 | Staria 750 | Yukon XL 980 | HiAce 850

## 4. Payment & Booking Policy
- 100% Pay on Arrival: Cash directly to chauffeur upon delivery at hotel in SAR or USD.
- Zero prepayment required.
- Free cancellation up to 24 hours prior to pickup.
- Airport waiting time: 60 minutes complimentary from flight landing.

## 5. Technology Stack & Security
- Next.js 15 App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase PostgreSQL with Row Level Security (RLS).
- Two-Factor Authentication (AAL2 TOTP) mandatory for owner and admin staff.
- Cloudflare Turnstile bot protection on all public submission forms.
- Sliding-window rate limiting on all public API endpoints.
